facts.business: Ashiana Housing Limited is an integrated real estate development company involved in identification and acquisition of land, planning, designing, construction, marketing of projects, and providing facilities management services, with product categories in Senior Living, Premium Housing & Elite Homes, and Kid Centric Homes.
key_risks: Assessment of carrying value of inventory involving estimates and judgement in determination of net realizable value (NRV) based on prevailing market conditions, estimated future selling price, cost to complete projects and selling costs
Revenue recognition involving significant estimates and judgements
